## Packages (15 on pub.dev)

### On-Device AI
- **ai_core_codespark** — Core embedding engine with offline MiniLM model (23MB). Powers semantic understanding without a server.
- **smart_suggestions_codespark** — Anchor-based item recommendations with MMR diversity ranking. Typed exceptions, web-compatible persistence.
- **semantic_search_codespark** — Query-driven semantic search with debounced input, MMR diversity, and typed results.

### Text & UI
- **dual_tone_text_codespark** — Dual-tone gradient text rendering with vertical/horizontal color splits.
- **horizon_scroll_codespark** — Parallax horizontal scroll layouts.
- **animated_percentage_indicator_codespark** — Animated percentage and progress indicators.
- **golden_rectangle_clipper_codespark** — Golden ratio-based clip shapes.
- **context_extensions_codespark** — Build context utility extensions.
- **dynamic_border_codespark** — Animated border widgets.
- **glass_morphism_codespark** — Frosted glass UI effects.
- **responsive_text_codespark** — Auto-scaling responsive text.
- **custom_icon_loader** — Custom loading indicators and icon utilities.

### Developer Utilities
- **resumable_upload** — Chunked file upload with retry logic and progress tracking for unreliable networks.
- **custom_media_player** — ExoPlayer-based video player with custom controls and playlist management.
- **text_renderer** — Rich text rendering with custom painter-based layouts.
